response.rationale: These look like two different concepts. A is a club booking, kept in its own store (`private readonly bookings = new Map<string, ClubBooking>();` in ClubBookingRepository, node 440da90bcde7901a). The graph shows ClubService uses it for club rates and invoicing (ClubService.setRate, getRate, invoice), and RinkService.effectiveCapacity reads it. That fits a club reserving rink capacity at a negotiated rate. B is an individual session booking. ReportService (node a663bd12cbc0090c) gets these through a separate BookingRepository.listBySession and checks a payment status (`} else if (b.status === "paid") {`). Each has its own repository, a different owner (a club vs a single customer per session) and its own lifecycle (club invoicing vs per-booking payment status). Both are reservations, but they model different real-world things.
